images.title: Every 12 from 2
images.purpose: Shows the numbers that leave remainder 2 on division by 3 and by 4 as equal jumps of 12 from 2: the form 12k + 2.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One number line across the middle with equal jumps above it and one caption.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal number line from 0 to 40 with 41 short ticks, one per whole number, longer ticks every 10 with no numerals. Exactly 4 teal (#0072B2) dots on the line at 2, 14, 26 and 38, each with its numeral under it. Three equal amber (#E69F00) jump arcs above the line from 2 to 14, 14 to 26 and 26 to 38, each labelled +12. Under the line, centred, one reddish purple (#CC79A7) caption box: 12k + 2. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Numbers that meet both remainder conditions repeat every 12, the LCM of 3 and 4.
images.description: Shows the numbers that leave remainder 2 on division by 3 and by 4 as equal jumps of 12 from 2: the form 12k + 2.

image_decisions.why: Equal jumps on a line show the repeating form of numbers with given remainders.
